ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping
District symbols as shown on Map No. 4-K

in the area bounded by:

West 16" Street; a line 74.00 feet west of and parallel to South Karlov Avenue; the
public alley next south and parallel to West 16" Street; a line 98 feet west and parallel
to South Karlov Avenue.

To those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 4109 W. 16" Street
